usedFor: Kitchen.co holds cards, notes and conversations, and Slack receives alerts through “Send Message” in a channel.

bestTemplate.name: “New Conversation Message” in Kitchen.co, then “Send Message” in Slack
bestTemplate.why: The team sees new conversation messages in a channel without opening Kitchen.co.

watchOut: An automation's post to a Slack channel waits for approval today, so “Send Message” does not appear instantly.
